description: This file implements platform-specific settings management for OpenThread using Zephyr OS's settings subsystem. It includes functions for initializing, reading, writing, deleting, and wiping settings, with internal context structures and callback functions.

classes.name: ot_setting_delete_ctx
classes.description: Context structure for deleting settings subtrees.

methods.name: ot_setting_delete_cb
methods.description: Callback for deleting settings entries during subtree deletion.

methods.name: ot_setting_delete_subtree
methods.description: Deletes a subtree of settings based on key and index.

methods.name: ot_setting_exists_cb
methods.description: Callback to check if a setting exists.

methods.name: ot_setting_exists
methods.description: Checks if a specific settings path exists.

methods.name: ot_setting_read_cb
methods.description: Callback for reading a setting value.
